import re

def parse_expenses(content):
    expenses = []
    lines = content.split('\n')
    for line in lines:
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            # Example: "- Timothy paid $200 for "Night Out". Owed equally by Sabrina and Timothy."
            match = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
            if match:
                payer = match.group(1)
                amount = float(match.group(2))
                description = match.group(3)
                debtors_str = match.group(4)
                # Split debtors by " and " or ", "
                debtors = re.split(r', | and ', debtors_str)
                expenses.append({
                    'payer': payer,
                    'amount': amount,
                    'description': description,
                    'debtors': debtors
                })
    return expenses
